description:
Where each HeritageDeed product works. Title search: the states and counties (with main cities) where a report
    can be ordered, what it includes and does not, and the price. Also: the Environmental Records Report, flood zone and
    Superfund lookups (any US address), the cities with building records, the places with property history, the
    counties with surplus funds and tax sale lists, and the calculators' states. Call this before ordering if you are
    unsure of the county; the list is live (new counties appear automatically).
name: list_coverage
